modbus.title: Connect to Ampere StoragePro E3
modbus.description: Enter the Modbus TCP endpoint. The work-mode selector can change the E3 mode through a direct, writable connection. Existing E3 integrations must first be removed because the device has a limited number of connections.

reconfigure.title: Change Modbus connection
reconfigure.description: Change the StoragePro E3 address or proxy endpoint. The storage system must remain the same.

topology.title: Select PV installation
topology.description: How many PV inverters or generation sources are connected? A single E3 uses its total and native counters; for multiple sources select non-overlapping channels next.

equipment.title: Choose equipment and polling
equipment.description: For multiple PV sources select only installed, non-overlapping MPPT and meter channels. The E3 total is not selectable; PV yield is calculated from sampled power.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key or insufficient permissions
error.invalid_installation: Installation is not accessible with this API key
error.invalid_options: Choose valid equipment, PV sources, and a valid polling interval or Modbus endpoint
error.modbus_conflict: An Ampere.IQ Modbus entry already exists, or the legacy StoragePro E3 entry has not been removed. Reconfigure the existing Ampere.IQ entry instead of adding another. A disabled legacy entry still blocks local Modbus; a proxy alone does not remove the conflict.
error.different_device: The endpoint belongs to a different StoragePro E3 device

abort.not_supported: This connection cannot be reconfigured here
